strings.Stop the selected downloads: Mete fen nan enpòte yo chwazi yo
strings.Select every download in this list (clic: Chwazi tout enpòte nan lis sa a (klike ankò pou deselekte)
strings.Remove the selected downloads from the l: Efase dosye yo chwazi nan lis la
strings.Remove finished downloads from the list: Mete dosye a nan lis la
strings.Download files from a website section: Telechaje fichye soti nan yon seksyon sit entènèt
strings.Download a numbered series of files: Telechaje yon seri nimewote de dosye
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: Klike sou Ajoute URL, kole yon lyen, mete yon lyen sou fenèt sa a, oswa telechaje li nan navigatè w la avèk ekstansyon an.
strings.Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…: Delete and Move File to Recycle Bin…
strings.Delete and Move File to Trash…: Delete and Move File to Trash…
strings.The new language is used after the app r: Lang nouvo a ap itilize apre aplikasyon an rekòmanse.
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: Telechaje, videyo ak torrents sèvi sèlman ak adaptè sa a (pou egzanp, VPN ou). Si li dekonekte, telechaje yo sispann an plas pou yo itilize yon lòt koneksyon.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Torrent blocklist: a file or an https:// address (empty = none)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Torrents pa janm konekte nan adrès nan lis sa a. P2P, DAT ak CIDR lis travay, tou kòm.gz. Yon adrès se telechaje ankò yon fwa chak jou.
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: Adrès listwa blokaj la dwe kòmanse ak https://
Fichiè blocklist la pa te jwenn.
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: Nouvo atik nan sa yo ap telechaje lè tit yo konfòme yo ak règ la: Fichiers ak videyo, ak torrents lè torrents yo sou. Yon règ lis mo ki dwe tout nan tit la, oswa yon / regex /.
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Telechaje atik ki gen tout mo sa yo nan tit yo (blan = chak atik)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: Sispann atik ki gen tit ki gen nenpòt nan mo sa yo
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Telechaje sèlman atik ki parèt apre flèch la te ajoute
strings.The feed address must start with http://: Adrès la dwe kòmanse ak http:// oswa https://
strings.The rule's regular expression is not val: Ekspresyon regilye règ la pa valab.
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: Tankou mwen itilize òdinatè a, limite telechaje a KB/s (0 = sou)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Tout vitès ankò apre yon minit san entrée sourit oswa klavye.
strings.Your API key for the service: Votre clé API pour le service
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Sit ki gen lyen ki pase pa li (separe pa virgule, e.g. example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Dezaktive pa default. Itilize kont ou an; lyen ki soti nan lòt sit yo pa janm voye nan sèvis la. Clé a se enkripte epi pa janm nan sauvegarde.
Tcheke pou pi piti yon lyen.
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Download limit: at most this many MB (0=no limit)
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: Lè kantite lajan an rive, telechaje yo sispann epi yo kontinye pa yo menm lè peryòd kap vini an kòmanse.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Antre adrès sit entènèt pwoksimite a (http:// oswa https://) oswa chemen konplè pou dosye a.
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Adrès pwoksimite (pou yon skript pwoksimite: adrès entènèt li oswa dosye)
strings.Put each package in its own folder: Mete chak pake nan dosye li
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Dezaktive archives yon pake lè tout bagay fini
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Kole tèks ak lyen, oswa adrès yon paj entènèt epi klike Chèche Lyen. Pati yon archive divize yo groupé nan yon sèl pake.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Sauvegarde tout galri a ak motè a galri (site tankou Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; motè a se telechaje premye fwa)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Lanse fenèt Ajoute nan dosye mwen te itilize dènye fwa a
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Wake the computer from sleep to start
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Itilize yon Windows wake timer; Power Options dwe pèmèt wake timers. Aplikasyon an dwe kouri (li ka nan bwat la).
strings.Getting the gallery engine (only the fir: Getting the gallery engine (only the first time)…
